{{dablink|For other uses of the words "earth" and "fire," see [[Earth (disambiguation)|Earth]] and [[Fire (disambiguation)|Fire]].}}
'''Spinning Earthfire''' is a [[weave]] of the [[One Power]]. Nothing is known about this weave, save that it was from the [[Age of Legends]]. [[Moghedien]] thought about this weave as well as [[Milking Tears]]. Due to its name, flows of [[Earth]] and [[Fire]] are probably involved.{{ref/book|6|39}} The name suggests that it could be related to controlling magma, or "earth fire."
